title: Grateful Dead Live at Moscone Convention Center on 1982-05-28
source: SBD: It's from a Pat Lee reel, Dick Latvala gave it to him. Maybe MC>R @3 3/4ips??  Maybe one more gen; Transfer info: Akai GX636 direct tape head output > Bottlehead tube tape pre w/ a pair of Telefunken tubes circa 1960 > Apogee Mini Me 24/96  > Apogee Mini DAC monitoring and mastering > FLAC; Tranfered June 2014 by Matt Smith

ai_review.summary: Warm, well‑meshed soundboard capture of a loose ’82 benefit set with standout Alabama Getaway and guest‑enhanced Walkin’ Blues despite minor mic glitches.
ai_review.review: The recording is a soundboard source that generally delivers clear, warm instrument tones, though it suffers from an occasional high‑pitched spook on “Alabama Getaway” and brief vocal‑mic dropouts. Musically the band offers a tight, blues‑rock set that feels organic and synchronized, highlighted by the guest appearance of John Cipollina on “Walkin’ Blues.” Overall the show is enjoyable for its simplicity and chemistry, even if it lacks the expansive jams of more celebrated dates.

ai_rating.rationale: Single detailed review rates the performance 4/5, praising musical cohesion and noting only minor recording flaws; this translates to a solid combined rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Overall warm and clear mix with well‑meshed instrument tones; occasional high‑pitched spook on “Alabama Getaway” and intermittent vocal mic dropouts for Jerry.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Straightforward rock‑blues benefit set with smooth transitions; no extended jam vehicles, giving a concise and organic feel.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Vocal mic drops noted; guitar tone blends well with the overall warm mix.
band_member_comments.Keys: Early Brent-era keyboards contribute to the warm, meshed instrument tones and show a settled sound.
